{0E}"I am none other than Mandelgius.{0F}
Monarch of beasts -- in other words! The BEAST LORD!"{w}{p}"I sense a power hidden within you all!{w}Yes, you have what it takes to become heroes!{w}

"Without further ado, I give you your first trial!{w}Go to the Blue Cave and catch the Azure Fish
that is said to live there!"{w}
"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{w}

{0E}"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{0F}
Go! Go forth and cut loose!!"{w}
"Ohh, well done coming back!{w}You are everything I believed you to be!!"{w}
"One Azure Fish, duly received.{w}Now then, if you'll excuse me."{w}

{0E}"Ohh, this is delicious! Too delicious!!{0F}
Ngah! ...A bone... in my throat!"{w}

{0E}"Whew... that was close...{0F}
But it was exquisite!{w}Now then, on to the second trial!"{w}

"Go to the deepest part of the Rinos Sea Volcano
and bring back the Proof of Endurance kept there!{w}And in its place, leave this Proof of Training!"{w}
"By enduring the searing heat, you will temper body and spirit{w}and forge a spirit and body no great evil can defeat!!"{w}
"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{w}

{0E}"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{0F}
Go! Go forth and cut loose!!"{w}

"I can tell!{w}You have withstood that heat and pain, I see!!{w}That's my disciples for you!!"{w}{p}"The Proof of Training you left behind
is a baton passed on to the next heroes!{w}A hero must also take on the raising of the next generation!!"{w}

"Now, the third trial!{w}Go to Miasuna and teach a lesson to the Evil Magistrate
who sits enthroned in the innermost chamber!!"{w}
"That scoundrel has long done evil while hiding in the dark!{w}Behind every evil,{w}there is always a root of all evil pulling the strings!!{w}
"Lurking in the shadows of the world of men, working evil,{w}{$09} you base and craven villain,{w}Mandelgius shall cut you down..."{w}

"What kind of hero lets evil run rampant
and just leaves it be!"{w}
"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{w}

{0E}"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{0F}
Go! Go forth and cut loose!!"{w}
"Ohh, well done coming back!{w}You are everything I believed you to be!!"{w}
"And so another great evil has been destroyed...{w}All thanks to your efforts.{w}I am overjoyed as well!!"{w}
"Now, the fourth trial!{w}You have no doubt noticed it yourselves."{w}
"Unleashed by the destruction of that great evil{w}-- another wicked aura..."{w}{p}"The fiend seized its chance and came back to life!{w}But its seal has not yet been fully broken!"{w}

"Now is the last chance
to seal the fiend away again!!"{w}{p}"Go to the Giaf Dunes{w}and do battle with Tiger Centaur III!!"{w}
"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{w}

{0E}"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{0F}
Go! Go forth and cut loose!!"{w}
"Ohh! Just what I'd expect from my disciples!!{w}There is no word for it but splendid!!"{w}
"To think you would endure every last one of my trials...{w}From this day forth, you may call yourselves heroes!!{w}
"But why did the seal come undone, I wonder...{w}Could someone have helped it along?{w}...I shall have to look into this myself."{w}
"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{w}

{0E}"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{0F}
Go! Go forth and cut loose!!"{w}

"Welcome to the Santorea Academy Faculty Building.{w}I study neither magic nor martial arts,
but the history of this land."{w}{p}"Bu-ut, it's tough going.
You hardly ever find a kid who likes history,
so I really feel like I don't belong..."{w}

"You're adventurers, right?
Will you be going to the Konnu Plains Ruins?"{w}{p}"Being ruins and all, that place has
lots of valuable things connected to ancient history
just lying there asleep."{w}{p}"So... just a quick look is fine.{w}Could I ask you to do some investigating?
Only if you get the chance to visit the ruins."{w}{p}"...Honestly, I'd like to go myself,
but school teachers have far less
free time than you'd think."{w}{p}"Just do it on the side, whenever.
I'm counting on you to survey those ruins."{w}

"Getting paid while doing research...
or so I thought, anyway.{w}Things never quite work out, do they?"{w}

You told the historian about the weathered
stone tablet you found at the Konnu Plains Ruins.{w}

"Mm-hm, now that is interesting...{w}I see... I'll look into the rest myself.
Thanks for your help."{w}

"What are you doing? It's already night."{w}
"Do you not understand when I tell you to go home!?!"{w}
"D-dismissal time...{w}was long... long past...{w}Even if it costs me my life, I WILL... send you home from school!!"{w}

With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}

A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
You succeeded in driving off the fearsome enemy.

"Wait, I haven't introduced everyone yet.{w}This is Mig.{w}A unicorn, as you can see."{w}{p}"Mig and I have been together since birth,{w}and Mig travels with me like this.{w}And..........."{w}
"Yamuru. I'm a bounty hunter.{w}I hear the Proclamation pays a pretty good sum,{w}so they've let me join this party."{w}
"My name is Korbitz.{w}We may end up relying on each other from here on,{w}so let's look out for one another, eh?"{w}
"The name's Mokero, it is!{w}The Miss has done a whole heap for me,{w}and I'll be followin' the Miss for the rest o' my days!"{w}

"Mokero, I keep telling you,
you don't have to be so formal..."{w}
"Miss! Don't go sayin' such cold things!{w}The debt I owe you, Miss, is............"{w}
"Electra's a kind child, you see,{w}and took us in, just like this.{w}So please, all of you, be good to Electra."{w}
"Ugh, honestly! You're all exaggerating!{w}If someone's in trouble, I help them.{w}
"Okay, okay, I get it!{w}Anyway, that's how it is, so be nice to all of us, okay?"{w}

"By the way... yours looks
like a pretty decent party."{w}

"We might end up competing with each other in all kinds of ways.{w}What do you say? How about you lot
and us have a little test of skill?"{w}
"These are the people who'll be our rivals from here on.{w}We need to see what they can do now, don't we?"{w}
"Besides, you need the bounty money, right?{w}Or was this something you started half-heartedly?"{w}

"Electra, what'll we do?
If you're going to fight, I'll help, okay?"{w}
"............Okay, I've made up my mind!"{w}{p}"You guys, let's have a match!{w}All right, everyone, let's go!!"{w}
"Ooh~ I'm gonna lop off some heads~!"{w}
"Not bad at all.{w}Still, Electra,{w}your alchemy spells are as half-baked as ever."{w}

"It's okay, Electra!
Your alchemy spells will get better from here on!"{w}
"It's all right,{w}there's no need to rush."{w}
"I'll be lendin' a hand too, I will!"{w}
